issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: List Trail Posts with Nearest Location, Distance Calculation & Search Filter

  • Issue: #587
  • PR: #586
  • Epic: #578 (trail-post)
  • Parent Task: BE-12 (#582 New GET /posts/trails Endpoint for the Trail Menu)
  • Date: 2026-10-05

1. Summary

Enhanced the GET /posts/trails endpoint to support real-time nearest location sorting (order=nearest), distance computation (distance_km), and search by place or city name (search), while standardizing on a single query-parameter-driven endpoint.

2. Related Tasks & Subtasks Reference

Subtask ID Issue / PR Deskripsi Status
BE-12.1 #582 Initial GET /posts/trails endpoint (Category 8, public, published, trail summary) ✅ Merged
BE-12.2 #585 N+1 batch query fix for trail summaries & SQL-level blocked posts filter ✅ Merged
BE-12.3 #586 Nearest location sorting (order=nearest), coordinate validation, distance calculation ✅ Implemented
BE-12.4 #586 Search by place or city (search param matching location_name & location_post via ILIKE) ✅ Implemented
BE-12.5 #586 Payload enhancement (category_name, latitude, longitude) & single endpoint cleanup ✅ Implemented

3. Files Created & Updated

  1. src/Action/V1/Posts/ListTrails.go:
    • Introduced QueryTrailsParams struct encapsulating offset, limit, safety lists, search, and coordinates.
    • Implemented SQL distance ordering and radius filtering using CockroachDB-safe ACOS/Haversine formula.
    • Added case-insensitive place and city search over location_name and location_post.
    • Added haversineDistanceKM helper to attach distance_km to response items on nearest sorting.
    • Added top-level latitude, longitude, and category_name: "Trail".
    • Removed redundant ElasticSearch post counter lookup to keep the feed endpoint fast and lean.
  2. src/Routes/V1/PostsRoutes.go:
    • Consolidated trail listing on single route GET /posts/trails.
  3. src/Action/V1/Posts/TrailPosts_test.go:
    • Added test cases:
      • TestListTrails_Nearest_Success: verifies nearest sorting and distance_km computation.
      • TestListTrails_Nearest_MissingCoordinates_Returns400: verifies 400 when coords missing.
      • TestListTrails_Nearest_InvalidCoordinates_Returns400: verifies 400 on invalid floats.
      • TestListTrails_Nearest_WithRadius: verifies radius parameter forwarding.
      • TestListTrails_Search: verifies place and city keyword search forwarding.
  4. api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Trail/List Trails.yml:
    • Updated Bruno collection documentation with order, lat, lng, radius, and search query parameters.
  5. docs/FE-HANDOVER-NOTES-TRAIL-POST.md:
    • Updated frontend handover guide.

4. Frontend Integration Guide & Contract

Endpoint

GET /posts/trails

Headers

Header Value Required Description
Authorization Bearer <JWT_TOKEN> Optional Authenticated session (supports viewer role)
ec "true" or "false" Optional Toggle AES-CBC response encryption

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
page integer No 1 Page number
limit integer No 10 Number of items per page
search string No - Search place or city name (e.g. Bogor, Subang, Gunung Pancar)
order string No newest Sort order: newest (by created_at) or nearest (by distance)
lat number Wajib jika order=nearest - User latitude (-90 to 90)
lng number Wajib jika order=nearest - User longitude (-180 to 180)
radius number No - Max radius filter in kilometers (optional)

5. Request & Response Examples

Example 1: Default (Newest First)

curl -X GET "https://api.panorra.com/posts/trails?page=1&limit=10"

Example 2: Search by City

curl -X GET "https://api.panorra.com/posts/trails?search=Subang&page=1&limit=10"

Example 3: Nearest to User Location with Radius

curl -X GET "https://api.panorra.com/posts/trails?order=nearest&lat=-6.5715&lng=107.7587&radius=25&page=1&limit=10"

Response (200 OK)

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,

      {

6. Verification & Tests Passed

All tests passed with 100% coverage for newest, nearest, radius, coordinates validation, and search filtering.

List Trail Posts with Nearest Location, Distance Calculation & Search Filter

  • PR: #586
  • Epic: #578 (trail-post)
  • Parent Task: BE-12 (#582 New GET /posts/trails Endpoint for the Trail Menu)
  • Date: 2026-10-05

1. Problem

The initial GET /posts/trails endpoint implemented in BE-12 only supported a static order by newest (created_at DESC) and lacked location-aware capabilities.

In the Panorra PWA "Trail Timeline" sidebar interface, users need to:

  1. Discover trails nearest to their current location with real-time distance indication (e.g. 12 m, 2.9 km).
  2. Search trails by place or city (e.g. "Bogor", "Gunung Pancar", "Bandung") using the search input bar.
  3. Plot map pins accurately using clean top-level coordinates (latitude, longitude).
  4. Keep the API surface clean, unified, and consistent via a single query-parameter-driven endpoint without redundant path routes.

2. Related Tasks & Subtasks Breakdown

This task builds directly upon BE-12 as an evolution subtask:

[Epic #578: Trail Post]
  └── [BE-12 #582: GET /posts/trails Feed Endpoint]
        ├── [Subtask BE-12.1] Basic Category 8 & Trail post filtering (Newest first)
        ├── [Subtask BE-12.2] Batch query trail summaries (N+1 fix) & SQL blocked posts filter
        ├── [Subtask BE-12.3] Nearest location sorting (`order=nearest`) & distance calculation
        ├── [Subtask BE-12.4] Search by place or city (`search` param matching location_name & location_post)
        └── [Subtask BE-12.5] API standardization & single-endpoint query parameter refactor

3. Scope

A. Location & Distance Sorting

  • Support order=nearest query parameter.
  • Accept user coordinates via lat (latitude: -90..90) and lng (longitude: -180..180).
  • Support optional radius parameter (in km) to filter trails within a specific distance radius.
  • Calculate distance in CockroachDB/PostgreSQL using Haversine/ACOS formula and order results by distance ASC.
  • Attach computed distance_km (rounded to 2 decimal places) to each post item in the response when order=nearest is used.
  • Reject requests with invalid or missing coordinates when order=nearest is requested with HTTP 400 Bad Request.

B. Place & City Search

  • Accept search query parameter.
  • Filter in SQL using case-insensitive ILIKE on location_name and JSONB location_post: 
    (COALESCE(location_name, '') ILIKE ? OR CAST(COALESCE(location_post, '{}'::jsonb) AS text) ILIKE ?)
  • Works seamlessly in combination with both order=newest and order=nearest.

C. Top-level Response Fields & Cleanup

  • Add "category_name": "Trail" to match sidebar category badges.
  • Expose "latitude" and "longitude" at root level of each item when available in location_post for easy map marker rendering.
  • Remove redundant engagement counters and ElasticSearch batch calls from this list endpoint (the PWA retrieves engagement aggregates via dedicated GET /posts/sl/agg/:sid).

D. Single Endpoint Architecture

  • Consolidate all listing, sorting, and search capabilities into a single clean endpoint: GET /posts/trails.
  • Eliminate redundant path-based routes (/posts/trails/nearest/...) to keep API conventions clean and predictable.

4. Behavior Boundary

  • Post Type: Strictly post_type = 'trail' and category_id = 8.
  • Visibility: Only visibility = 'public' and is_publish = true.
  • Safety Filters:
    • Banned posts (posts.banned = false) and banned users (users.banned = false) are excluded.
    • Blocked posts (slug NOT IN (?)) and deactivated/blocked users (encrypt NOT IN (?)) are filtered at SQL level.
  • Authorization: Accessible by user and viewer roles (header Authorization optional).
  • Encryption: Supports response encryption via ec: true header.

5. Acceptance Criteria

  • GET /posts/trails?order=newest returns published, public trail posts ordered by created_at DESC.
  • GET /posts/trails?order=nearest&lat=-6.58&lng=106.90 returns trails ordered by distance ASC, each including distance_km.
  • GET /posts/trails?search=Bogor returns trails matching "Bogor" in location_name or location_post.
  • GET /posts/trails?search=Bogor&order=nearest&lat=-6.58&lng=106.90&radius=25 combines search, radius filter, and nearest sorting.
  • Invalid coordinates or missing coordinates on order=nearest return HTTP 400.
  • All unit tests in panorra-api-go/src/Action/V1/Posts pass cleanly without database or network dependencies.

issues.display_title: Issue #588: GoThru Integration: Get Tour Panoramas (GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/panoramas)
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Get Tour Panoramas GoThru Integration

  • Issue: #588
  • Endpoint: GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/panoramas
  • Provider Endpoint: GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key}/panoramas
  • Reference Spec: GoThru-API-New/docs/v2/tours/management/internal-user-virtual-tours.md#get-internalusersuuidvirtual-tourstour_keypanoramas
  • Date: 2026-10-05

1. Summary

Implemented the client and handler integration in panorra-api-go to fetch the ordered list of panoramas for a user's virtual tour from the GoThru APIL provider, including coordinate normalization, caching, error mapping, and unit tests.

2. Files Created & Updated

  1. src/Models/GoThruIntegration.go:
    • Added CleanTourPanorama struct (ID, Sequence, Name, Lat *float64, Lng *float64, Altitude float64).
    • Added GoThruTourPanoramasResponse struct for provider payload unmarshaling.
  2. src/Utils/GoThru/GoThru.go:
    • Implemented FetchTourPanoramas(keycloakUUID, tourKey string, page, perPage int).
    • Injects Keycloak service token, strips UTF-8 BOM, maps 404 to virtual tour not found, and sanitizes 403 provider responses.
  3. src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourPanoramas.go:
    • Implemented GetTourPanoramas(c *fiber.Ctx) handler.
    • Validates user auth and non-empty tour_key.
    • Resolves keycloak_sub via ResolveKeycloakSub.
    • Unlinked user returns 200 with linked: false and data: [].
    • Integrates 60-second Redis caching per user, tourKey, and page.
    • Normalizes coordinates (lat/lng nullable) and altitude.
  4. src/Controllers/V1/GoThruIntegrationControllers.go:
    • Added controller GetGoThruTourPanoramas.
  5. src/Routes/V1/GoThruIntegrationRoutes.go:
    • Registered GET /virtual-tours/:tour_key/panoramas.
  6. src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourPanoramas_test.go:
    • 5 unit tests covering 401 unauthorized, empty tourKey 400, unlinked user 200, success transformation, and 404 tour not found.
  7. api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/GoThru/Get Tour Panoramas.yml:
    • Added Bruno collection request and examples.

3. Frontend Integration Guide

Endpoint

GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/panoramas

Headers

Header Value Required Description
Authorization Bearer <JWT_TOKEN> Yes Authenticated user session
Accept application/json Yes MIME type

Path Parameters

Parameter Type Required Description
tour_key string Yes The tour key identifier (e.g. u1NXOiVK)

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
page integer No 1 Page number
per_page integer No 20 Records per page (max: 100)

4. Response & Examples

Example Request

curl -X GET "https://api.panorra.com/gothru/virtual-tours/u1NXOiVK/panoramas?page=1&per_page=20" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>"

Response (200 OK)

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "linked": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 128456,
      "sequence": 1,
      "name": "PANO_0001.jpg",
      "lat": -7.942493,
      "lng": 112.953012,
      "altitude": 0
    },
    {
      "id": 128457,
      "sequence": 2,
      "name": "PANO_0002.jpg",
      "lat": null,
      "lng": null,
      "altitude": 2100.5
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "total": 2,
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 20,
    "total_pages": 1
  }
}

Response (404 Not Found - Tour Not Owned / Nonexistent)

{
  "statusCode": 404,
  "data": {
    "status": "Not Found",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Virtual tour not found"
    }
  }
}

5. Verification & Tests Passed

go test ./src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/... -v -count=1

All 17 tests passed with 100% success rate without live database or network access.

Get Tour Panoramas GoThru Integration

  • Endpoint: GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/panoramas
  • Provider Endpoint: GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key}/panoramas
  • Reference Spec: GoThru-API-New/docs/v2/tours/management/internal-user-virtual-tours.md#get-internalusersuuidvirtual-tourstour_keypanoramas
  • Date: 2026-10-05

1. Problem

When managing and inspecting a GoThru virtual tour or creating detailed waypoints from individual nodes in a tour, client applications (Panorra PWA / Web) need to retrieve the ordered list of panoramas that belong to a specific virtual tour (tour_key).

The GoThru provider API (GoThru-API-New) now exposes an internal endpoint:
GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key}/panoramas

Panorra API acts as the requestor backend. It must resolve the authenticated user's Keycloak UUID (keycloak_sub) via user_keycloak_link, acquire a Keycloak service account token, call GoThru APIL, normalize the panorama attributes (including nullable coordinates lat/lng and sanitized numeric altitude), cache the response for 60 seconds in Redis, and return a clean HTTP 200 response to the Panorra frontend.

2. Scope

  • Models:
    • Create CleanTourPanorama in src/Models/GoThruIntegration.go:
      • id: integer
      • sequence: integer (1..n ordering)
      • name: string (filename, e.g. PANO_0001.jpg)
      • lat: nullable float (*float64)
      • lng: nullable float (*float64)
      • altitude: numeric float (float64)
    • Create GoThruTourPanoramasResponse DTO for provider deserialization.
  • Client:
    • Implement FetchTourPanoramas(keycloakUUID, tourKey string, page, perPage int) in src/Utils/GoThru/GoThru.go.
    • Injects Keycloak service token, X-Requestor-App: panorra, and Accept: application/json.
    • Strips leading UTF-8 BOM if present.
    • Maps 404 to ProviderError (tour not found), 401/403 to sanitized Unable to connect to GoThru service, 400 to bad request.
  • Action Handler:
    • Implement GetTourPanoramas(c *fiber.Ctx) in src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourPanoramas.go.
    • Requires authenticated session (userId), returns 401 if missing.
    • Validates tour_key path parameter, returns 400 if empty.
    • Unlinked users return 200 with data: [] and linked: false.
    • Database errors during keycloak link resolution return 500.
    • Supports pagination: page (default 1), per_page (default 20, max 100).
    • Caches response in Redis for 60 seconds with key:
      {prefix}_gothru_panos_{userId}_{tourKey}_{page}_{perPage}
    • Normalizes lat & lng as *float64 (null when unassigned).
    • Returns HTTP 200 with linked: true, data: CleanTourPanorama[], and pagination.
  • Controller & Routes:
    • Add GetGoThruTourPanoramas to src/Controllers/V1/GoThruIntegrationControllers.go.
    • Register route GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/panoramas in src/Routes/V1/GoThruIntegrationRoutes.go.
  • API Collection:
    • Create api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/GoThru/Get Tour Panoramas.yml.
  • Unit Tests:
    • Add test suite in src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourPanoramas_test.go covering 401 unauthorized, empty tour_key, unlinked user, success transformation, and 404 tour not found.

3. Acceptance Criteria

  • Authenticated user can fetch panoramas for their tour.
  • Unlinked user receives 200 with linked: false and data: [].
  • Missing or empty tour_key returns 400 Bad Request.
  • Nonexistent or unowned tour returns 404 Not Found.
  • Panoramas without GPS coordinates return lat: null, lng: null.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly without database or network.

issues.display_title: Issue #590: GoThru Integration: Get Tour Links (GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/links)
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Get Tour Links GoThru Integration

  • Issue: #590
  • Endpoint: GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/links
  • Provider Endpoint: GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key}/links
  • Reference Spec: GoThru-API-New#2010

Get Tour Links GoThru Integration

  • Endpoint: GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/links
  • Provider Endpoint: GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key}/links
  • Reference Spec: GoThru-API-New#2010
  • Date: 2026-10-06

1. Problem

When visualizing a GoThru virtual tour's navigation graph, floor plan, or constellation connections on a map or 360 viewer, consumer applications (Panorra PWA / Web, Villume) need an internal endpoint to retrieve the polyline links connecting panorama nodes for a specific virtual tour (tour_key).

The GoThru provider API (GoThru-API-New) exposes an internal endpoint:
GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key}/links

Panorra API acts as the requestor backend. It must resolve the authenticated user's Keycloak UUID (keycloak_sub) via user_keycloak_link, acquire a Keycloak service account token, call GoThru APIL (forwarding the optional level_id parameter), cache the response for 60 seconds in Redis, and return a clean HTTP 200 response to the Panorra frontend.

2. Scope

  • Models:
    • Create GoThruTourLinksResponse in src/Models/GoThruIntegration.go:
      • data: array of polyline link coordinate arrays ([][][]string or []interface{}).
  • Client:
    • Implement FetchTourLinks(keycloakUUID, tourKey, levelID string) in src/Utils/GoThru/GoThru.go.
    • Injects Keycloak service token, X-Requestor-App: panorra, and Accept: application/json.
    • Forwards level_id query parameter when provided.
    • Strips leading UTF-8 BOM if present.
    • Maps 404 to ProviderError (virtual tour not found), 401/403 to sanitized Unable to connect to GoThru service, 400 to bad request.
  • Action Handler:
    • Implement GetTourLinks(c *fiber.Ctx) in src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourLinks.go.
    • Requires authenticated session (userId), returns 401 if missing.
    • Validates tour_key path parameter, returns 400 if empty.
    • Unlinked users return 200 with data: [] and linked: false.
    • Database errors during keycloak link resolution return 500.
    • Caches response in Redis for 60 seconds with key:
      {prefix}_gothru_tour_links_{userId}_{tourKey}_{levelId}
    • Returns HTTP 200 with linked: true and data: [...].
  • Controller & Routes:
    • Add GetGoThruTourLinks to src/Controllers/V1/GoThruIntegrationControllers.go.
    • Register route GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/links in src/Routes/V1/GoThruIntegrationRoutes.go.
  • API Collection:
    • Create api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/GoThru/Get Tour Links.yml.
  • Unit Tests:
    • Add test suite in src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourLinks_test.go covering 401 unauthorized, empty tour_key 400, unlinked user 200 with empty array, success with level_id, and 404 tour not found.

3. Acceptance Criteria

  • Authenticated user can fetch panorama link connections for their virtual tour.
  • Unlinked user receives 200 with linked: false and data: [].
  • Missing or empty tour_key returns 400 Bad Request.
  • Nonexistent or unowned tour returns 404 Not Found.
  • Optional level_id query parameter is forwarded to provider.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly without database or network.
